usageNotes: Use this to inspect the cloud-init configuration of a QEMU VM, showing both the values that were used to generate the currently active cloud-init image and any pending changes not yet applied. A config change is only reflected in the VM after a cloud-init image regeneration (via the update endpoint) followed by a reboot — this endpoint lets you detect that drift before it bites you. Requires VM.Audit on the target VM.

examples.summary: Get cloud-init config for VM 105 on node pve1, showing current vs pending values

tips: Items with a 'pending' field but no 'value' field are newly added options not yet baked into the drive image.
Items with 'delete': 1 are staged for removal but still active until the cloud-init drive is regenerated.
Both 'value' and 'pending' being present on the same key means the option was changed but the drive hasn't been rebuilt yet — the VM is still running with the old value.
Cloud-init changes only take effect after regenerating the drive (POST /cloudinit) and rebooting the VM; this read endpoint is safe to poll without side effects.
